observations: Photo 0 shows a single automotive headlight assembly with black housing.
The lens is clear with a projector-style inner unit and an amber turn signal section at the bottom.
The text "HONDA AND ACURA" appears as a semi-transparent watermark across the image, not as a label on the part.
A second partial headlight is visible at the bottom left corner.
The background appears to be a workshop floor with other car parts scattered around.

claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension for all models of Honda, Acura and Toyota cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a headlight assembly, not body panels, engines, or suspension parts

risks.risk: The headlight lens may be cracked, cloudy, scratched, or have moisture inside.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens surface, interior reflectors, and mounting tabs.

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit the buyer's specific Honda, Acura, or Toyota model or year.
risks.proof: Photo of the part number, electrical connector, mounting points, or a vehicle fitment list.

risks.risk: The headlight may be sold without the bulb, ballast, or wiring harness.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear of the unit showing the bulb socket and wiring connector.

proof_requests: Close-up of the headlight lens, housing, and mounting condition.
Photo of the rear connector, bulb socket, and any visible part number.
Photo indicating whether this is a left or right headlight.
response.reason: The item in the photo is clearly a car headlight assembly, so it can be priced at its worst case despite the seller's broader claim about body, engine, and suspension parts.
